scope: Read-only performance diagnosis of running Zulu35 study; no production changes

source_signal.name: SignalGuide
source_signal.loader_rule: One widest whole-signal time window for every traded symbol, extended for GMT candidates.

separate_bar_refresh_readonly_snapshot.meaning: Observed cache activity updated attempt metadata; these 61 pairs did not store refreshed bars since this run began.

findings.fact: Every original gap save executes combined MIN(epoch),MAX(epoch) across all finalized bars of this feed/symbol, even for empty responses. This aggregate traverses the pair, rather than two indexed endpoint seeks.

findings.certainty: code and actual EXPLAIN plan verified
findings.fact: Every original gap save executes global DELETE WHERE gueltig_bis<=now. No expiry index exists in actual schema; EXPLAIN reports SCAN h1_abrufversuche.
findings.cost_shape: O(gap_saves * global_attempt_rows); grows with accumulated gap state

findings.certainty: code and matching retained attempt timestamps
findings.fact: SDK gap ranges already bundle old internally bounded gaps within 31 days, but speichere remains inside the original-gap loop. ~1000 attempt rows therefore do not imply ~1000 SDK calls.
findings.gap_semantics: Each original range retains its own TTL. Existing bridge bars returned by broad SDK calls are discarded, preserving original cached OHLC.

findings.fact: Only actual finalized H1 bars prove coverage; internal empty ranges become eligible again after 24h. No calendar classification is used. This is why old empty ranges are retried.

findings.certainty: current code contract; per-signal invocation count not instrumented
findings.fact: If first reconstruction is not reliable, each additional feed gets a complete reconstruction, intentionally multiplying distinct feed/symbol gap work. Cache remains separated by terminal/server/exact symbol.
Every symbol receives the widest complete signal window, not only that symbol's actual trade interval; safe later scope optimization needs proof that GMT/FX and timing evidence stay identical.

findings.certainty: code bound only; no live RPC profiling
findings.fact: An empty _hole_terminal_h1 response can trigger 3 sleeps of2seconds and4SDK reads total. This is not evidence that the present bundled responses were empty: they may contain known bridge bars.

isolated_benchmark.important_limit: These are synthetic local costs, not an exclusive attribution of live process CPU or an end-to-end speedup guarantee.

smallest_unapplied_proposal.changes: Two indexed first/last finalized-bar lookups plus an expiry index. Keep global cleanup SQL, TTLs, original gaps, bars, RPC logic and all forensic rules unchanged.
smallest_unapplied_proposal.activation: Only in a separately reviewed idle window after current study ends. No schema or source activation during current run.

expiry_index_vs_feed_local_cleanup.expiry_index: Recommended minimal semantic change: same global cleanup, planner seeks expired range. Schema/index creation must wait for a separately approved idle activation, never during current study.
expiry_index_vs_feed_local_cleanup.feed_symbol_local: Can reduce scans using current primary-key prefix, but changes global cleanup into local cleanup and leaves other feeds expired metadata until used; storage cleanup/state changes. Not the smallest semantic-preserving proposal.
expiry_index_vs_feed_local_cleanup.no_global_loop_broadening: No proposed reclassification of empty intervals, no calendar assumptions, no shortened retries, no invented coverage.

limitations: Attempt rows are latest keyed state, not an append-only RPC log; exact total RPC retries and time per signal cannot be recovered from them.
No exclusive CPU profile was taken, so the measured structural amplification is a proved avoidable cost, not proof of its exact share of wall time.
Different empty-gap widths (including22,47,70hours) are not classified as weekends or holidays.
No TTL, gap coverage, calendar, broker, price, tick, or positive-verdict rule was changed.
studies35_binding_audit: Pending actual finished receipt; not started while production process is active.
